name: oh-my-memory
description: Local/CI runtime memory and crash instrumentation toolkit

scripts.build: bun build src/index.ts --outfile dist/index.js --target bun --format esm && bun build src/cli.ts --outfile dist/cli.js --target bun --format esm && tsc --emitDeclarationOnly
scripts.hook:pre: bun run src/cli.ts hook --config configs/local.json --stage pre-test -- bun run typecheck
scripts.hook:during: bun run src/cli.ts hook --config configs/local.json --stage during-test -- bun test
scripts.hook:post: bun run src/cli.ts hook --config configs/local.json --stage post-test -- bun run build
